summary: E3: shell equivalents of the two PowerShell gates so the Godot headless suites can run on Linux and in CI

coordination.notes: E1 owns .github/** in the same round; this task adds no workflow. The Windows gates tools/build-native-bridge.ps1 and tools/verify-godot.ps1 are left untouched and remain the Windows path. game/bin/project42_sim.gdextension declares only windows.* libraries, so the Linux .so this build script produces is not yet registered by Godot; game/ is inside the active claim backend-p0-unify-expedition-spines, so that entry is left for its owner and for E2. The suites were never executed here: no Godot binary exists in this environment. The scripts were proved against a logging stub engine that records every invocation, so the command sequence, ordering, enumeration and exit-code propagation are verified while the GDScript assertions remain unverified until a runner with Godot 4 exists (E2).
